reason: The SDK offline-shell plugin now builds with register: false, so the Editor owns when its service worker registers. One small module (offline-shell.ts) holds that scheduling: register the same worker, scope and module type after the first usable render (or a fallback delay on screens that never open a collection), once the main thread is idle. It exports the testable scheduler and the browser instance, imported by main.tsx and App.tsx. No new route, network surface, credential use or SDK/protocol surface.
